task_production_rates.notes: Placeholder expressed per SF protected; environment drives big variance.
Masking is highly variable; active construction increases scope.
Vacuuming surfaces and ledges; slower in cluttered/active environments.
Wipe-down used selectively; more likely higher tiers.
Represents distributed minor touch-ups averaged over area; refine with defect density tracking.
Higher tiers demand more feathering discipline.
Placeholder; spray-only can be higher; roll-only lower; backroll adds separate task.

factor_modifiers.description: Active construction increases protection, dust control, and rework risk.
factor_modifiers.notes: Use higher end when other trades are present during priming.

factor_modifiers.description: Spray + backroll improves uniformity but adds a full backroll pass.
factor_modifiers.notes: This factor exists mainly as a selection flag; the labor is captured by adding the task.

factor_modifiers.description: Level 5 expectations require higher inspection rigor and more sanding/touch-up sensitivity.
factor_modifiers.notes: Used when drywall_finish_level is level_5 and quality level is QL-5.

quality_effects.description: Standard inspection and limited touch-up; prime is functional sealer step.
quality_effects.notes: Wipe-down and post-prime sanding are selective.

quality_effects.description: More consistent dust control and defect correction; higher inspection sensitivity.
quality_effects.notes: More likely to include wipe-down and post-prime spot sanding.

quality_effects.description: Strict readiness standard; additional inspection and sanding expected, often paired with higher-build primer strategy.
quality_effects.notes: Critical lighting and defect sensitivity assumed.

assumptions: Rates are placeholders and must be calibrated; they exist to validate the artifact pipeline and mapping.
risks: Declared drywall finish level may not match actual workmanship; correction scope may expand.
Masking/protection workload can dominate primer time in active construction environments.
validation_plan: Calibrate spray-only vs roll-only vs spray+backroll productivity on real jobs.
Track defect density (touch-ups per 100 SF) by drywall finish level to refine touch-up time.
Validate primer waste factors and coverage with job logs.
